auditTarget: Authority Trust Boundary implementation in SimulationAuthorityInternal.ts and CanonicalDomainBindingEngine.ts

findings.title: Module-Scoped Key Isolation Confirmed
findings.evidence: authoritySecretHMAC and activeKeyVersion are module-level variables with no exports. The getAuthorityBootKey() export has been removed.

findings.title: Seal Issuance Internalization
findings.evidence: sealBinding() no longer accepts an authority symbol key. It performs sealing via internal calls to computeHMACSealToken().

findings.title: Implicit Trust of Execution Context String
findings.evidence: sealBinding accepts an optional executionContext string (default 'CORE_EXECUTION'). This string is incorporated into the HMAC but is not validated against a known policy or caller identity.
findings.reproducibility: Any module can call sealBinding(binding, 'ANY_CONTEXT') and receive a valid seal for that context.
